ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: A rectangular piece of iron, with a length of 25 cm and a width of 15 cm, has small squares with a side length of 2 cm cut from each of its four corners. Then, by folding up the four sides, a lidless iron box is made. What is the volume of the iron box in liters?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} By the problem statement, we have: the length of the iron box $= 25 - 2 \times 2 = 21\,\text{cm}$, the width of the iron box $= 15 - 2 \times 2 = 11\,\text{cm}$, the height of the iron box $= 2\,\text{cm}$,\\
$\therefore$ the volume of the iron box $= 21 \times 11 \times 2 = 462\,\text{cm}^3 = 0.462$ litres.\\
Thus, the volume of the iron box is $\boxed{0.462}$ litres.
